prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and the services you need. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me narrow it down:

- What marketing services do you need? (digital ads, SEO, social media, branding, PR, content, B2B demand gen, etc.)
- Are you a small business, mid-market, enterprise or nonprofit?
- Industry or target audience (consumer, healthcare, finance, education, government)?
- Monthly or project budget range?
- Do you prefer a local agency (Maryland) or are remote/national agencies OK?

How to pick the best agency (checklist)
- Clear match to your needs (services and channel expertise)
- Proven results: case studies and measurable KPIs (traffic, leads, CPA, ROI)
- Industry experience with similar clients
- Transparent pricing and reporting cadence
- Client references and reviews (Clutch, Google, UpCity)
- Team size and structure (will you get a dedicated strategist?)
- Cultural fit and communication style
- Contract terms, deliverables and exit options

Places to search and vet agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity for verified reviews and rankings
- Google Maps / Yelp for local ratings
- LinkedIn for team/company background and client posts
- Local business publications/awards (Baltimore Business Journal, AMA Baltimore)

If you tell me the answers to the questions above (or just your top priorities), I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match and summarize their strengths so you can compare them. Which services and budget are you working with?
